<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD is a straightforward Rust package for `mirador` sourced from its own upstream GitHub repository (`https://github.com/jchultarsky/mirador`). The `source` array fetches a tagged release tarball (`v${pkgver}.tar.gz`) from the project's own GitHub, and a SHA256 checksum is properly pinned — not SKIPped. There is no `pkgver()` function, no top-level command substitution, no `eval`, no obfuscated strings, and no network calls beyond the declared source archive. The `prepare()`, `build()`, `check()`, and `package()` functions are irrelevant to this gate because `--noprepare` and `--nobuild` prevent them from running. Sourcing the PKGBUILD only executes variable assignments (`pkgname`, `pkgver`, `_gitversion`, `_ghurl`, etc.) and array definitions, which are all safe.
</details>
<evidence>
